subject: Activation: stub line repair & spend cap recalibration
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah O'Neil <sarah.oneil@crestline.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO stubline and spend cap question

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending the onboarding form yesterday. I skimmed Crestline's intake packet and noticed the provisional PO you attached is using a placeholder stub line (line item labeled "STUBLINE-RESERVE") rather than the final SKU-level items our billing team needs to issue a definitive PO number.

Two asks to unblock:
1) Can you confirm the SKU breakdown (unit pricing + qty) to replace the STUBLINE? We need the granularity for each cost bucket (ingest, storage, inference).
2) Your onboarding form lists an initial monthly forecast that exceeds the provisional spend cap we provisioned. If the forecast is accurate, we will need to recalibrate the spend cap and update the provisional PO before activation. What's the expected first 30-day consumption?

I've attached the PDF form and the provisional CSV you sent. If it's easier, we can do a 20-minute call to walk the items and finalize the PO. Monica, tagging you here to help with the SKU mapping once Crestline confirms.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: Crestline_Onboarding_Form_11-19.pdf (PDF), provisional_po_STUB-20261119.csv (CSV)

From: Sarah O'Neil <sarah.oneil@crestline.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@crestline.io
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO stubline and spend cap question

Ben —

Appreciate the quick review. Sorry about the STUBLINE — that was left in by our procurement system when we exported the draft. Full answers below:

1) SKU breakdown (effective month 1):
   - INFER-CPU-1: inference compute (100,000 tokens) — $0.0025/token — qty 1 — line total $250
   - S3-STORE-50: storage (50 GB) — $0.10/GB — qty 50 — line total $5
   - DATA-INGEST: data ingress/setup — one-time — $1,200

I've attached an updated CSV with those lines. Please confirm the formatting you need for your PO system.

2) Forecast: we expect bursty usage during month 1 with a projected total spend of $2,800 (includes safety buffer). The provisional cap you created was $1,500, so yes we'd need that raised. Our procurement team can provide a justification note if required.

We can do a quick call Monday morning (11/23) at 9:30 PT if that works.

—Sarah
Sarah O'Neil
Head of Finance Operations, Crestline Analytics
sarah.oneil@crestline.io

Attachment: Crestline_PO_Lines_20261120.csv (CSV)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah O'Neil <sarah.oneil@crestline.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO stubline and spend cap question

Sarah —

Thanks for the SKU detail and the updated CSV. That layout is perfect for our procurement flow. Karthik — can you confirm the process to update the provisional PO to a definitive PO once we accept these lines and the spend cap is adjusted? Specifically:

- Does Procurement need Crestline to sign a spend justification doc (we can route a short note from their procurement email)?
- After cap update, will the PO number change (we need a stable PO number to attach to the activation ticket)?

Monica, flagging that forecast of $2,800 vs. our provisional $1,500 — please advise next steps on cap escalation and whether a temporary override (up to $3k) is possible while legal finalizes terms.

If no objections, I'll accept the SKU lines and request the cap change. We can attach Crestline's procurement note and the CSV to the PO.

Best,
Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO stubline and spend cap question

Ben / Monica —

Quick update from procurement: we can escalate the provisional spend cap to $3,000 for a 30-day provisional window provided Crestline's procurement team sends a one-paragraph justification and a PO-export CSV matching our internal schema (the CSV Sarah attached is close; we need the columns in order: ponumber, account_code, sku_id, qty, unit_price, line_total). Once we have that we will:

1) Reissue the provisional PO as a definitive PO (PO numbers change when we move from STUB to ACTIVE — new PO will be issued but the ticket will be updated and mapped so your activation team sees the change).
2) Backdate the ledger entry to the activation day so accounting has a continuous trail.

Action items:
- Sarah: can you re-send the CSV with the exact column order above and copy a one-line justification (e.g., "Initial activation expected with bursty inference usage; requesting provisional cap increase to $3,000 to cover month one").
- Monica: I'll hold the cap escalation until we receive those two items; please confirm you can process a temporary $3k window.

Once received I'll push the PO through and share the definitive PO number (and HubSpot link) immediately.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
